codes.not-logged-in: You are not logged in. Log in and try again.
codes.not-ready: Obelisk is still starting. Try again in a moment.
codes.offline: You are offline. Check your connection.
codes.no-relays-connected: Could not connect to any relay.
codes.extension-missing: No Nostr browser extension found. Install or unlock one and try again.
codes.extension-no-nip04: Your browser extension cannot encrypt or decrypt NIP-04 messages.
codes.extension-no-nip44: Your browser extension cannot encrypt or decrypt NIP-44 messages.
codes.signer-no-nip44: Your signer does not support NIP-44 encryption.
codes.signer-unsupported: Your login method cannot sign this here. Log in with an extension or a remote signer.
codes.pq-unavailable: Post-quantum encryption needs a browser extension that supports it.
codes.signer-timeout: Your signer did not answer in time. Check it and try again.
codes.publish-timeout: No relay answered in time. Check your connection and try again.
codes.auth-refused: The relay did not accept your authentication.
codes.not-whitelisted: This relay only accepts keys on its list, and yours is not on it.
codes.invalid-relay-url: That is not a valid relay address. Use a public wss:// address.
codes.dms-off: Direct messages are turned off in your settings.
codes.files-need-nip17: Encrypted files need NIP-17, and this conversation uses NIP-04.
codes.own-packs-only: You can only delete your own packs.
codes.profile-load-failed: Could not load your current profile. Try again.
codes.profile-lookup-timeout: Looking up the profile took too long. Try again.
codes.mute-list-load-failed: Could not load your mute list. Try again.
codes.invalid-bunker-url: That bunker address is not valid.
codes.bunker-missing-secret: The remote signer pairing is incomplete. Pair it again.
codes.bunker-no-session: There is no remote signer session to restore. Log in again.
codes.call-relay-failed: Could not reach a relay for the call.
codes.game-unconfirmed: The relay never confirmed the table. It may still appear in a moment, so check the channel before creating another.
codes.nwc-invalid-uri: That is not a Nostr Wallet Connect link. It starts with nostr+walletconnect:// and names a relay and a secret.
codes.nwc-unreachable: Could not reach that wallet on its relay. Check that the wallet is online and the link is still valid.
codes.nwc-cannot-pay: That connection is not allowed to pay invoices. Create one with payment permission in your wallet.
codes.wallet-timeout: Your wallet did not answer in time. The payment may still go through: check your wallet before trying again.
codes.wallet-relay-failed: Could not reach your wallet's relay. Nothing was paid.
codes.wallet-rate-limited: Your wallet is getting too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
codes.wallet-not-supported: Your wallet does not support this request.
codes.wallet-insufficient-balance: Your wallet does not have enough funds.
codes.wallet-quota-exceeded: This would go over the spending limit your wallet set for Obelisk.
codes.wallet-restricted: Your wallet does not allow this connection to make that payment.
codes.wallet-unauthorized: Your wallet no longer accepts this connection. Connect it again in Settings.
codes.wallet-payment-failed: Your wallet tried the payment and it failed. Nothing was paid.

panel.title: Something broke on this screen
panel.body: The chat surface hit an error and stopped rendering. Your keys and your messages are safe: nothing was lost, this is only the view. Try again first; if it keeps happening, clearing the local cache rebuilds it from the relay.
panel.cleared: {count, plural, one {Cleared # entry} other {Cleared # entries}}, reloading…
